To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we show the first example of a machine learning system for controlling a robot with visual perception only and that we develop a system that can autonomously learn target reaching with a robotic manipulator using only visual observations.

a) a DQN can learn to perform target reaching with visual perception only, b) the DQN can be transferred from simulation to hardware, but only when using synthetic camera images instead of real ones, and c) this approach is not limited to a specific task, as it can be extended to other tasks such as object picking
we have shown for the first robot that can learn to control its own motion from visual input only, using deep learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: Can a robot learn to control itself from visual perception alone?
the following question: Can we learn a robotic controller from visual perception only?
the development of a machine learning based robotic controller that can learn from visual input only.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DQN is able to learn to control the robotic system, but the learning process is not as fast as it could be and it requires a lot of time.
the network works with simulated observation, but not with real observation.

the DQN is able to learn to reach the target in a simulation environment, but fails to transfer to real hardware, even though it is able to learn the task in real hardware when given synthetic images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DQN can be used to control a robotic arm with visual perception only, and that the network works well when trained in simulation, but that it needs to be fine-tuned in the real system.
we have successfully demonstrated the capability for a robot arm to learn a controller for target reaching using only visual perception.
we were able to learn a target reaching task for the real robot using visual perception only, but the learning process is not as efficient as in simulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the network can learn a target reaching policy from synthetic images.
the network is able to learn a controller from visual perception only.
the DQN learns to control the robot in simulation.
